notes: Built once: createTournament(settings, {ledger, schedule, seating}). Pure over a TournamentState; times are milliseconds on the table's action clock. Codes: notAllowed. levelAt and clockInfo take milliseconds on the level clock: game-clock elapsed(clock,'level').

settings.startingStack: integer, default 5000; the only starting-stack number the tournament uses (every entry is issued this through the ledger); chip-ledger's own startingStack is not read by it
settings.lastRebuyLevel: integer, default 3; a rebuy is offered only when the level a round was dealt at is at most this

start.returns: TournamentState (every seat enters with startingStack issued through the ledger)

roundStarted.returns: TournamentState (records each active entry's stack for ranking bust-outs)

roundSettled.returns: TournamentState (active entries with no chips become pendingBust; each with a rebuy left, at a level up to lastRebuyLevel, gets an offer; a computer's offer carries autoAt = actionMs + computerDelayMs)

levelClockRuns.returns: boolean (false while rebuy offers are open: the level clock stands still; pass as runs.level to game-clock advance)

dueOffer.returns: {playerId,accept}|null (computer: accept at autoAt; person: decline at deadline)

resolve.returns: {ok:true,state}|{ok:false,code:notAllowed} (accepting issues rebuyStack and uses a rebuy)

conclude.returns: {state,outcome:continue|completed,winnerId} (pending bust-outs still without chips go out and are placed; one entry left wins; with no person left the computers are placed by stack and a clear leader wins)

cancel.returns: TournamentState (finished, no winner, places made stand)

standings.returns: Standing[] (placed entries by place, then the rest)
